label: EXPLORATORY until the M6 freeze; developed on the dev split only (hard rule 6)
note: Tables the M5 oracles read (harness/src/oracles/). The rules that use them are described in protocol/oracles/README.md. Every entry that decides what counts as detection is a hard-rule-12 item for the owner.

axeSymptoms.note: Arm A: an axe rule whose violation count at a step is higher in every candidate attempt than in every base attempt is a new violation. A rule listed here gives FAIL with its symptom; any other new violation gives REVIEW. Grouped by what the axe rule checks: an accessible name, a role, or a state or property; rules about headings, landmarks and hidden focusable content are grouped with navigation.

reachabilityFamily.note: Proposed for scoring: the HANDOFF §6 definitions of these three symptoms overlap (a step the journey cannot get past), and the M3 catalogue assigns them by mechanism, not by evidence. A FAIL with any member counts as the correct symptom for an item labelled with any member. The oracle still names the member its structural rule finds.

componentRoles.note: Composite widgets and popups a documented key (Escape) should leave; used to tell KEYBOARD_TRAP from FOCUS_NOT_RESTORED.

nvda.source: NVDA 2026.2, en-GB: role words as P23/P24 (harness/src/runner/goals.ts); symbol names from source/locale/en/symbols.dic, only symbols spoken at NVDA's default punctuation level (some); state labels from NVDA's controlTypes state names.
